summary: Frontend-only E2E test of redesigned customer dashboard (mobile 390x844 then desktop 1920x800) for +919000000004. Verified: no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth==innerWidth==390) on Home, My Bookings, after timeline expand and filter chips; Home hero 'Hi Priya' + home-book-now navigates to '/', home-wallet-chip -> Wallet; spotlight (#AZORUGKAV, 'Finding your partner' pill) home-active-open prefills search with code and shows exactly 1 highlighted card (ring-2), home-active-viewall selects Active chip; quick actions qa-bookings/qa-wallet/qa-addresses/qa-support land on right sections; home-stats 3 tiles (16 / 2 / ₹250); home-refer -> Refer & Earn; home-recent shows exactly 4 rows and click opens that booking. Bottom nav with tab-home/orders(badge 8)/wallet/profile/more; more-sheet lists all menu items and navigates (My Invoices verified). Section header with back-home (mobile only) + book-new. My Bookings: chips with counts (All 16, Active 8, Searching 1, Ongoing 7, Completed 2, Cancelled 6), Cancelled filter shows only cancelled cards, search narrows to 1, clearing restores; pagination 'Showing 1–5 of 16' -> next '6–10 of 16', page buttons 1-4, prev disabled on p1, next disabled on last, filter change resets to page 1. Mobile timeline toggle shows latest ('Cancelled' + time + 'All 4'), expands chronologically Booked→Paid→Searching→Cancelled, 'Hide' collapses; desktop shows horizontal timeline with mobile block display:none (and vice versa on mobile). Desktop: sidebar first item Home, no bottom nav, 4 stat cards row above filters on My Bookings, no overflow. Wallet shows ₹250 balance + transactions, My Profile renders with Priya Verma, Cancel buttons present on all 5 active cards and enabled. Zero console errors on every screen.

issues: Quick action tiles stretch full container width (~330px each) with a small centered icon+label, looking sparse/unbalanced; consider capping tile width or a horizontal chip row on lg+
Top app header bar is an empty white strip on desktop (no title/search), wasting vertical space
Sheet duplicates the 4 primary bottom-tab items (Home, My Bookings, Wallet, My Profile) in addition to the secondary items; spec listed only secondary items. Cosmetic/deviation only, navigation works
